by virtue of the powers vested in me by law, do hereby repeal
Executive Order No. 212, series of 1994.
This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila,
the year of Our Lord, Nineteen Hundred
and Ninety-Seven.
By the President:
